styleLock.direction: industrial cordless power-tool ecommerce, hard-edged and readable
styleLock.backgroundSystem: only two alternating background systems across the whole set: a matte seamless light studio sweep #F4F5F7 and a deep charcoal matte panel #2B2D31 with a soft top falloff; no third style, no random textures
styleLock.lightingSystem: hard directional side key from the left that rakes across metal and moulded shell into long narrow specular streaks, thin rim light from the right to separate silhouette from panel, deep short contact shadow that always grounds the tool, no flat frontal fill
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio sweep; material tiles or moulded ribs where the shot needs a working surface, always with visible grain and machining marks rather than smoothed plastic
styleLock.typography: heavy modern geometric sans-serif with condensed headline weights only, headline 26-42pt, label 13-18pt, Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and driven by placeholders, hairline rules and one short accent divider as the only decoration
styleLock.iconSystem: solid circular badges and single thin leader-line callouts in #F2A02A, one graphic device per shot, no illustration, no 3D icons, no certificate artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: tool kept upright and stable with consistent scale across the set, side and 3/4 angles always show the same grip-and-base silhouette, working end points left except in the closing shot, product never floats and always carries a contact shadow
noDrift: no mixed fonts or handwritten type
no inconsistent lighting or flipped key direction
no invented voltage, torque, rpm or capacity figures rendered as real numbers
no fabricated display screens, dashboards or app UI
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial cordless power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte studio light grey #F4F5F7, deep charcoal panel #2B2D31 and charcoal text #2D2D2D, with one accent color {accent_color} pinned to tool orange #F2A02A and one soft secondary accent #F2D21B; cool-neutral tone; heavy modern geometric sans-serif with condensed headline weights only; two alternating background systems only, matte light studio sweep and deep charcoal panel, no third style; hard directional side key light from the left raking metal and moulded shell into long narrow specular streaks, thin rim light from the right, deep short contact shadow grounding the tool, no flat frontal fill; visible grain and machining texture, never over-smoothed plastic; solid circular badges and single thin leader-line callouts as the only graphic devices; stable product scale and upright placement, working end pointing left except in the closing shot; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers rendered as real values, no fabricated display UI.

provenance.notes: 11 张详情页切片（_sources/锂电钻/panels panel-01..11）拆解出的视觉语法，非复刻原图。已剥离：机身与电池包上的品牌压印与型号字样、参数环数字、店铺会员角标与二维码、联系方式类信息、原图整段中文文案与英文装饰字、原图字体版式；所有电压/扭矩/转速/容量/尺寸数值一律改为 {callout_N} 占位符，禁止生成时回填成真实数字；电池对比不落地为伪造显示屏 UI，改为印刷式标尺与实体结构。原图 1 台主品（充电式冲击电钻）为唯一主体，套装配件仅作品类通用道具。品类判定以图为准：主体为手持电动工具，L1 取 家装灯具 与来源大类（五金）一致；L2 在 家装灯具 下的 五金 与 五金工具 两个候选中取 五金工具（电动工具归类），与来源标注的 五金 属同 L1 近邻，特此说明。差异化：与库内已有的吹塑内衬收纳工具箱套装、双色柄活动扳手、精抛老虎钳、百叶轮砂布胶候、便携汽油发电机、淋浴花洒、墙面温控器、管夹支架主题均不同，本模版专属电动工具视觉体系（侧光机身/夹头齿纹/扭矩环/扳机变速/快拆电池包/档位卡）。
